news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹18.23 (up from ₹9.37 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹26.7b (up 65% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.26b (up 158% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 16% (up from 10% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) surpassed analyst estimates by 21%. Revenue is forecast to grow 10% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Hospitality industry in India.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates increase by 14%, revenue downgraded
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2026 has been updated. 2026 revenue forecast fell from ₹25.1b to ₹24.6b. EPS estimate rose from ₹13.15 to ₹15.04. news.title: Consensus EPS estimates increase by 35%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has improved. 2026 revenue forecast increased from ₹24.6b to ₹25.3b. EPS estimate increased from ₹11.34 to ₹15.35 per share. Net income forecast to grow 8.1% next year vs 42% growth forecast for Hospitality industry in India. Consensus price target up from ₹856 to ₹889. Share price rose 2.8% to ₹779 over the past week.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.00 (up from ₹1.06 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹7.22b (up 35% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.17b (up 424% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 16% (up from 4.2% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 4.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 11%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 22% growth forecast for the Hospitality industry in India.
